record.question: A 35 years old male patient is brought to the emergency room after he sustained multiple injuries from a road traffic accident. which of the following assessment should take the highest priority?
options: Grey turner's sign in the flank
record.explanation: Answer D: A deviated trachea. A deviated trachea after major trauma can indicate tension pneumothorax, an immediately life-threatening airway/breathing emergency. Source/context note: It is a late sign; clinical management follows trauma resuscitation protocols. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK448124/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
